title: Continuity of Composite Functions
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine the interval on which h(x) = sqrt(9 - x^2) is continuous.

steps.title: Find the Natural Domain
steps.explanation: Square root requires a non-negative radicand.

steps.title: Examine Interior Continuity via Composition
steps.mathExpression: g(x) = 9 - x^2 \text{ is continuous on } \mathbb{R}, \quad f(u) = \sqrt{u} \text{ is continuous for } u \ge 0
steps.explanation: A composition f(g(x)) of continuous functions is continuous on its domain.
steps.why: Theorem on continuity of composite functions.

steps.title: Check One-Sided Boundary Continuity
steps.explanation: The right-hand limit matches at -3 and the left-hand limit matches at 3.
steps.why: Endpoint continuity requires one-sided limit matching.
